lifecycle.retention: Preserve the simple quick picker and distinguish project diagnostics from destructive workspace actions.

value.goal: The broader search, diagnostics and archive workflow still needs scope and acceptance.
value.implementation: Existing settings show project identity and change counts. Quick selection stays name-only, with the active project marked and storage operations owned by the registry.
value.source_verification: Check existing selector and registry behavior before admitting search, diff summary, explicit sync and archive actions.
value.merge: The existing registry and settings are in the adopted frame. The combined workflow has its own delivery.
value.runtime_verification: Verify project selection during active recording, diagnostics permissions and archive/return on the agreed projects.
value.release: A release follows the accepted scope of each added action.
